name: Akitonian Physiology
body:
Akitonian Physiology (Ex) [Doorway to the Red Star]
Source Mythic Realms pg. 9
When you select this path ability, you permanently reshape your body in imitation of the alien species of Akiton, permanently gaining the benefits of one of the following alchemist discoveries: chameleonARG, preserve organsUM, tumor familiarUM, or vestigial armUM. Your alchemist level for the purpose of this ability is equal to your tier plus your alchemist level. You can select this path ability multiple times, each time selecting a new permanent mutation. Each time beyond the first that you take this path ability, your pool of mythic power is permanently reduced by 1 (as that power is used to maintain your alien physiology) and you take a cumulative –1 penalty on all Charisma checks and Charisma-based skill checks when interacting with animals, fey, and humanoids.
